schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
schemes.description: Zero-balance savings account with free RuPay debit card, 2 Lakh rupees accident insurance, and up to 10,000 rupees overdraft facility.
documents: Voter ID or Driving License if Aadhaar unavailable

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
schemes.description: Accidental death and disability insurance cover of 2 Lakh rupees for a nominal annual premium of 20 rupees.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
schemes.description: Life insurance cover of 2 Lakh rupees for death due to any cause for an annual premium of 436 rupees.

schemes.name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
schemes.description: Guaranteed monthly pension of 1,000 to 5,000 rupees after age 60 for unorganized sector workers and non-taxpayers.

schemes.name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
schemes.description: High-interest tax-free small savings scheme for a girl child under 10 years of age, maturing when she turns 21 or gets married after 18.
documents: Aadhaar and PAN card of parent or guardian
Passport photos of parent and child

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
schemes.description: Collateral-free business loans up to 10 Lakh rupees for micro enterprises, artisans, shopkeepers, and self-employed individuals.
documents: Bank account statements for past 6 months

schemes.name: Senior Citizen Savings Scheme (SCSS)
schemes.description: Government savings scheme offering high quarterly interest payouts and tax deduction under Section 80C for individuals aged 60 and above.
documents: Age proof document like Aadhaar card or Senior Citizen Card

schemes.name: Sovereign Gold Bonds (SGB)
schemes.description: Government-backed gold bonds paying 2.5 percent annual interest plus market appreciation on gold, with zero capital gains tax at 8-year maturity.
documents: Aadhaar card or voter ID for address proof
Bank account details for payout credit
